implementationScope: package-only progressive JFIF 4:2:0 incremental session with semantic-unit marker streaming, exact-MCU transactional transport and phase-separated retained/operation authority

cases.mechanismPressure: every encoded byte boundary plus every completed-scan preview; all previews must alias one session-owned RGB backing
a 132270-byte entropy scan is more than 319 times the 414-byte transport authority; committed MCU prefixes must keep residency within the syntax-derived transaction ceiling
every RST marker is split after its 0xFF byte, forcing transactional MCU rollback across marker boundaries

requiredInvariants: The 65537-byte maximum encoded marker segment is a file-format extent, not a residency requirement. Length-bearing marker headers are consumed first; semantically skippable APP/COM payloads stream-discard under declared-length metadata accounting.

The largest retained marker semantic unit is one DHT definition: one selector byte, 16 code-length counts and at most 256 symbols = 273 bytes. DQT commits 65-byte tables; JFIF, ICC and Adobe authority need only 14, 12 and 12 payload bytes respectively.

The qualified single-MCU entropy bound is derived across scan modes rather than from corpus observation: AC-first is 1642 bits (62 longest coefficient symbols plus a longest EOBRUN), interleaved DC-first is 162 bits and AC-refine is conservatively 1085 bits. Worst-case byte stuffing plus a restart marker makes the transport authority 414 bytes, which dominates the 273-byte marker semantic unit.

A maximum-length 65537-byte COM marker must stream through transport without whole-marker residency; legal ordinary-marker and restart-marker FF fill longer than two maximum marker segments is normalized and reclaimed incrementally.

Entropy-coded data accepts exactly FF 00 for one stuffed FF byte. The non-standard FF FF ... 00 compatibility pattern is fail-closed so an unbounded non-marker FF run cannot widen one MCU transaction.
Pre-frame DQT/DHT state is normalized into four quantization slots and eight Huffman slots; repeated marker definitions overwrite finite semantic state rather than retaining marker history.
The pre-frame table arena is released after SOF2 state transfer. The 768-byte six-block rollback buffer is operation-only scratch and is not charged to retainedBetweenCalls.

JFIF source authority is structural and ordered: the complete APP0 main-header fields must be valid and the JFIF marker must be the first marker after SOI. Adobe APP14 is accepted only when transform=1 agrees with JFIF YCbCr; embedded ICC and conflicting Adobe RGB/YCCK fail closed before rasterization.
Every MCU is transactional: suspension restores coefficient blocks, DC predictors, EOBRUN, restart index and entropy bit state to the pre-MCU checkpoint.
Caller-owned append Data is borrowed only for the call. Cross-call encoded retention is limited to the 414-byte transport buffer, and committed entropy/marker prefixes are reclaimable.
The 576x576 retained case must remain within the 414-byte transport authority while its largest entropy scan is 132270 bytes; corpus occupancy is an observation, not the proof of the domain bound.
Every report requires final RGB bytes to equal the complete-input independent decoder byte-for-byte and completed scan numbers to be contiguous from 1 through the final scan.
Every-completed-scan preview evidence must observe exactly one preview per scan and one stable session-owned RGB backing across all previews.

Before finish, retainedBetweenCalls equals transport plus ImageCraft-owned state plus one RGB output; operationPeak is the maximum of the SOF2 transition coexistence and steady retained bytes plus transactional rollback scratch. After finish, the ledger is terminal zero state.

This profile does not qualify non-JFIF color authority, embedded ICC, other sampling modes, public DecodedImage representation, physical RSS, allocator bookkeeping or perceptual reconstruction quality.
